# Fred Wright & Gilbert Blythe

- [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) — Comrade of — [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — traveling together to Green Gables to investigate news · since v2  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P10](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0010), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) travel around to canvass for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), collecting subscriptions for repairs to the local hall. Along the way, they encounter various eccentric neighbors, including the pessimistic [Eliza Andrews](../character/eliza-andrews.md) and her optimistic sister Catherine, a flustered Mr. Blair whom they help bake a cake, and the excessively neat Mrs. Theodore White.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), truthfulness, and the Village Improvement Society's hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it was accidentally painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. Although the society members are devastated, the incident earns them widespread sympathy from the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), discussing community news and Marilla's improving eyesight. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learn that the twins' uncle cannot take them until autumn, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps correct Davy's funny theological misunderstandings after catching him eating plum jam. Later, at an [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, the members are appalled to learn that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a patent medicine company for advertising, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) fail to persuade him otherwise.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> In the weeks leading up to Miss Lavendar's wedding, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays busy helping with preparations and discussing the upcoming romantic events with [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), Charlotta the Fourth, and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally discovers [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) together in the garden, learning of their secret romance. The following evening, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide in [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about her engagement, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to reflect on love, change, and her own dreams for the future.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose
